description:
Transfer STX tokens to a recipient address. Signs and broadcasts the transaction.

Example: To send 2 STX, use amount "2000000" (micro-STX).
1 STX = 1,000,000 micro-STX

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amount.description: Amount in micro-STX (1 STX = 1,000,000 micro-STX). Example: '2000000' for 2 STX

fee.description: Optional fee: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' preset or micro-STX amount. Clamped to 3,000 uSTX max for STX transfers. If omitted, medium-priority fee is auto-resolved. Ignored when sponsored=true.

memo.description: Optional memo message to include with the transfer

recipient.description: The recipient's Stacks address (starts with SP or ST)

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

name: transfer_stx
